Interception Controls
Neutralize Network Location (Pure GPS Only)
Drop network provider fixes and requests across system_server and GMS while keeping pure GPS satellite fixes untouched.
Block GMS Wi-Fi & RTT Scans
Return empty Wi-Fi scan results and drop Wi-Fi RTT ranging for Google Play services without affecting normal Wi-Fi connectivity.
Block GMS Cell Tower Info
Return empty cell tower lists to Google Play services without affecting calls, SMS, or mobile data.
Block GMS BLE Background Scans
Drop Bluetooth Low Energy scans initiated by Google Play services without affecting paired devices.
Block Location-Off Privilege Bypass
Strip locationSettingsIgnored flags from GMS requests so turning off Location truly stops location delivery.
Verbose Debug Logging
Log intercepted calls under tag PlaceboLA for verification via adb logcat.
Recommended LSPosed Scope

Required:
• System Framework (android)
• Google Play services (com.google.android.gms)

Recommended hardening:
• Google Services Framework (com.google.android.gsf)
• Phone Services (com.android.phone)
• Bluetooth (com.android.bluetooth)
